critique: FAIL: 1. **Severe text truncation in parallelogram cards**: The `skewX(-15)` transform causes all three card titles to overflow their containers. 'Multi-Head Attention' appears as 'Multi-Head Attentio', 'Syntactic Dependencies' as 'Syntactic Dependenci', and 'Anaphora Resolution' as 'Anaphora Resolution' (partially cut). The skew transform shifts content rightward while the text-anchor='middle' positioning doesn't account for the visual distortion. **Fix**: Remove `transform='skewX(-15)'` from all three `<g>` elements and use standard rectangular cards with `rx='8'` for rounded corners. 2. **Bullet point text overflow in cards**: The bullet text in all three cards is truncated due to the same skew transform. **Fix**: After removing skew, adjust bullet text `x` positions to `x='140'`, `x='520'`, `x='900'` respectively with `width='280'` text wrapping consideration. 3. **Excessive empty space on right side**: The canvas has ~400px unused width after the image card. **Fix**: Enlarge image from `width='250' height='160'` to `width='400' height='256'` and reposition to `x='800' y='450'`, or add explanatory text block to the right of image. 4. **Missing visual hierarchy**: All cards use identical `#0A3D8F` fill with no accent colors. **Fix**: Add colored header strips with `fill='#00C9A7'` for card 1, `fill='#FF6B6B'` for card 2, `fill='#4ECDC4'` for card 3 by inserting `<rect x='100' y='160' width='320' height='40' fill='#00C9A7'/>` before body text. 5. **No takeaway sentence**: Content page lacks assertion headline format. **Fix**: Add subtitle text `<text x='130' y='115' font-size='20' fill='#4A5568'>` with 'Attention heads specialize in distinct linguistic functions, enabling interpretable model behavior'.
